mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.driver_id AS driverId, d.name AS driverName, v.truck_type_id AS truckTypeId, tt.type_name AS truckTypeName, v.license_plate_number AS licensePlateNumber, v.vehicle_brand AS vehicleBrand, v.create_time AS createTime, v.update_time AS updateTime, v.create_user AS createUser, ca.name AS createUserName, v.update_user AS updateUser, ua.name AS updateUserName FROM vehicle v JOIN driver d ON v.driver_id = d.id JOIN truck_type tt ON v.truck_type_id = tt.id LEFT JOIN admin ca ON v.create_user = ca.id LEFT JOIN admin ua ON v.update_user = ua.id WHERE v.id = #{id}
mapper.update:
UPDATE vehicle
driver_id = #{driverId},
truck_type_id = #{truckTypeId},
license_plate_number = #{licensePlateNumber},
vehicle_brand = #{vehicleBrand},
update_time = #{updateTime}, update_user = #{updateUser},
WHERE id = #{id}
